versions.changelog:
- Initial release of yq-weixin-connect skill for connecting personal WeChat accounts (not WeCom).
- Implements a strict, step-by-step workflow for user-initiated WeChat personal QR binding; not triggered by "企业微信"/"企微"/"WeCom".
- Ensures installation of the legacy plugin version, QR code generation via the qrcode npm library, and secure upload/display methods.
- Enforces QR image upload via upload_to_cdn with workspace fallback, QR code validity handling, and strict credential writing.
- Prevents improper methods (e.g., direct download of QR URL, alternate image hosts, or skipping steps) to maximize connection success and user experience.
